next.reason: 1985: "allowable combinations of characters in the COBOL character set used as symbols"; 2023: "The currency symbol can be selected from the set of allowable characters from the computer's compile-time coded character set.". Both require allowable symbol combinations, with category set by the 4.x GRs. 1985 limits all symbols to the COBOL character set; 2023 lets the currency symbol come from outside it.
